definitions.gloss: 90th birthday; celebration of one's ninetieth year
definitions.explanation: A traditional celebration of a person's 90th birthday. The name comes from the informal simplified form of {卒|そつ}, whose components can be read as {九十|きゅうじゅう} (ninety).

examples.japanese: {卒寿|そつじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、{卒寿|そつじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother turns ninety next month.

examples.japanese: {卒寿|そつじゅ}のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧たちが⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The grandchildren wrote letters to celebrate her ninetieth birthday.

notes:
{卒寿|そつじゅ} celebrates a person's 90th birthday, one of the traditional Japanese longevity milestones (⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧). The name comes from the informal simplified form of {卒|そつ}, whose components can be read as {九十|きゅうじゅう} (ninety); the traditional celebratory color is purple.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卒寿|そつじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach one's ninetieth year
- {卒寿|そつじゅ}のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: a 90th-birthday celebration

TYPES:
Part of a sequence of longevity milestones: ⟦{古希|こき}→古希：29070_koki⟧ (70), ⟦{喜寿|きじゅ}→喜寿：29071_kiju⟧ (77), ⟦{傘寿|さんじゅ}→傘寿：30987_sanju⟧ (80), ⟦{米寿|べいじゅ}→米寿：30988_beiju⟧ (88), {卒寿|そつじゅ} (90), ⟦{白寿|はくじゅ}→白寿：30990_hakuju⟧ (99).
